# The DozalDevs dashboard: pages, menus and buttons

<!-- Generated from the dashboard's own code by the dashboard map generator. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every step you give a person for the dashboard (app.dozaldevs.com) names only pages, menu rows and
buttons listed here, with the exact words shown here, in the person's language. Write each page as a
link to its address (for example [Connected apps](https://app.dozaldevs.com/dashboard/integrations)) and
each button as a link to the page it is on, so the person can click it and the words can be checked.
Never write a step from memory: if what you need is not on this list, link the page and say you are not
sure of the button's name, instead of inventing one.

## On every page

The menu (left side on a computer, the bottom bar's More on a phone): **Activity**, **Connected apps**, **Dozals**, **Home**, **Settings**. The search box at the top finds every page and these actions by name:

- **Hire a Dozal** (Contratar un Dozal): Describe a job and we’ll set someone up.
- **Connect two Dozals** (Conectar dos Dozals): Have one Dozal start when another one finishes.
- **See what runs on a schedule** (Ver qué se ejecuta según un horario): Every Dozal that runs on a timer, and when it runs next.
- **Group Dozals into departments** (Agrupar Dozals en departamentos): Sort your Dozals into teams, like Sales or Support.
- **Connect an app** (Conectar una app): Link the tools your Dozals work in.
- **Add a website** (Agregar un sitio web): Let a Dozal build and keep up a website.
- **Invite a teammate** (Invitar a un compañero de equipo): Give someone access to this organization.
- **Make a role for your team** (Crear un rol para tu equipo): Start from a role you know and switch jobs on or off.
